name: domain-guardian
description: Keeps AI coding agents grounded in project-specific business rules, user flows, and operational context.

interface.shortDescription: Ground code changes in business flow.
interface.longDescription: Domain Guardian gives AI coding agents a structured project memory for business models, domain rules, critical user flows, operational context, and code ownership boundaries. It prepares business-flow-aware task context before edits, guides agents to ask onboarding questions, creates domain impact briefs, and reviews diffs against the rules behind the code. It ships Codex plugin metadata and Claude Code slash command support.
defaultPrompt: Use Domain Guardian before changing domain-sensitive code.
Prepare Domain Guardian pre-change context before editing code.
Onboard this project with Domain Guardian.
